tasks.title: Port the qsurl Rust crate into rust/qsurl/
tasks.parallelism_notes: No dependencies: creates the self-contained crate rust/qsurl/ from the user tarball; touches no existing file. Its maturin module-name string 'querysource.qsurl._qsurl' only names the install location — it is not a use of querysource/qsurl/__init__.py from TASK-765 (cargo test and the example never import Python). cargo builds into the worktree-local rust/qsurl/target, not the shared .venv.

tasks.title: qsurl Python package core (parse API, QSUrlError, capabilities, ResidualPlan)
tasks.parallelism_notes: No dependencies: creates querysource/qsurl/{__init__,errors,capabilities,plan}.py and tests/qsurl/{__init__,conftest}.py; back-end imports are lazy so neither the Rust crate nor the Lark fallback is needed.

tasks.title: Lark fallback parser (grammar.lark + _fallback.py)
tasks.parallelism_notes: Needs QSUrlError and capabilities.ALL from TASK-765 (querysource/qsurl/errors.py, capabilities.py) to raise errors and order `requires`; cross-checks its output against the example CLI of the crate from TASK-764 (rust/qsurl/Cargo.toml, rust/qsurl/src/parser.rs is the grammar it mirrors).

tasks.title: Rust/Lark parity corpus, parity tests and perf test
tasks.parallelism_notes: Generates expected IR by running the example CLI of the crate from TASK-764 (rust/qsurl/examples/parse.rs) and checks _fallback.parse from TASK-766 (querysource/qsurl/_fallback.py) against it.

tasks.title: GBNF export of the qsurl grammar (to_gbnf)
tasks.parallelism_notes: Converts grammar.lark and imports GRAMMAR_PATH from TASK-766 (querysource/qsurl/_fallback.py); validates against tests/qsurl/corpus.json created by TASK-767.

tasks.title: PostgreSQL ILIKE / NOT ILIKE dict operator (Rust + Cython builders)
tasks.parallelism_notes: Exclusive: rebuilds the shared _qs_parsers extension into .venv (make build-rust) and the Cython parsers in place (make build-inplace), which every other task's tests import. No code dependency on other tasks.

tasks.title: Declare qsurl capabilities / residual_scan on providers
tasks.parallelism_notes: Imports querysource.qsurl.capabilities constants from TASK-765; pgProvider may declare text_match only once TASK-769 adds the ILIKE dict operator to rust/src/pgsql_parser.rs and pgsql.pyx.

tasks.title: IR to pushdown conditions + ResidualPlan (translate.split)
tasks.parallelism_notes: Imports QSUrlError, ResidualPlan and capabilities from TASK-765 (querysource/qsurl/errors.py, plan.py, capabilities.py); pure function, takes capabilities as an argument so it does not need TASK-770.

tasks.title: Residual evaluator (residual.apply), eval-free pandas stage
tasks.parallelism_notes: Imports ResidualPlan and QSUrlError from TASK-765 (querysource/qsurl/plan.py, errors.py) and uses the stores_df fixture from tests/qsurl/conftest.py created there.

tasks.title: QS residual stage + QSURL_MAX_RESIDUAL_ROWS cost guard
tasks.parallelism_notes: QS._apply_residual calls residual.apply from TASK-772 (querysource/qsurl/residual.py) and types the kwarg with ResidualPlan from TASK-765 (querysource/qsurl/plan.py).

tasks.title: Client-safe detail in the error envelope + QSUrlError pass-through in DataOutput
tasks.parallelism_notes: querysource/outputs/output.py imports QSUrlError from TASK-765 (querysource/qsurl/errors.py) to re-raise it; the envelope change itself is independent.

tasks.title: QSUrlService handler and /api/v1/services/qsurl/{path:.*} route
tasks.parallelism_notes: Calls parse/QSUrlError from TASK-765, reads provider.capabilities/residual_scan from TASK-770, calls translate.split from TASK-771, passes QS(residual=...) from TASK-773 and raises Error(detail=...) from TASK-774.

tasks.title: End-to-end dry-run tests for qsurl (parse, split, QS)
tasks.parallelism_notes: Asserts ILIKE rendering added by TASK-769, uses pgProvider/cassandraProvider.capabilities from TASK-770, translate.split from TASK-771 and QS(residual=...)/_apply_residual from TASK-773.

tasks.title: Build and ship the _qsurl extension (Makefile, release.yml, package-data, uv.lock)
tasks.parallelism_notes: Exclusive: maturin develop into the shared .venv and `uv lock` rewrites uv.lock. Builds rust/qsurl/Cargo.toml from TASK-764, stages into querysource/qsurl/ from TASK-765, and its package-data test checks grammar.lark from TASK-766.

tasks.title: qsurl dialect reference (docs/QSURL.md)
tasks.parallelism_notes: Documents to_gbnf() from TASK-768 (querysource/qsurl/gbnf.py) and the final route plus 400 envelope from TASK-775 (querysource/handlers/qsurl.py).
